# Test fixtures

`official-0.28.0.avex` is copied from the AliasVault source tree:

`aliasvault/core/client/src/transfer/import/importers/aliasvault/__tests__/aliasvault.avex`

It is an official example `.avex` export, licensed AGPL-3.0-or-later together
with AliasVault. The tests use it only to check that this independent
implementation reads the real format. Its export password is
`testexportpass123`; it contains synthetic test data, not a real vault.
